prompt:
Phone app screen, portrait 9:16 aspect ratio, flat-on view, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The personal expense tracker's home screen organised so capture comes first.

Ground: clean white #FFFFFF, near-black #111827 text, grey #6B7280 secondary.

Top line: a small grey month label "September 2026" on the left, and on the right a small amber pill "2 waiting to parse" with a 6 pixel amber dot, on pale amber #FDF4E3 with #8A5A12 text.

Below it, the largest element on the screen: a bordered capture field with 16 pixel rounded corners. Inside on the left, a large grey prompt in Bengali "কী কিনলেন?" with a smaller English line beneath it reading "Type, speak, or photograph a receipt". Inside on the right, two 34 pixel circular keys: a muted grey microphone key, then a filled blue #2563EB camera key with a white camera glyph.

Then a bordered month card: a 27 pixel total "৳ 24,850" with a small green "12% vs August". Beneath it a 9 pixel horizontal stacked bar in four flat segments — amber #B4741B, blue #2C5FA8, green #2F7A3E, purple #8A3E8A. Beneath the bar a single-line legend: Food ৳ 10,400, Transport ৳ 6,000, Groceries ৳ 4,700, Health ৳ 3,750.

Then a row of five rounded filter chips, the first filled near-black with white text (All), the rest in light grey #F3F4F6 with dark grey text: Food, Transport, Bills, Health.

Then a day-grouped ledger. Each day header: a bold date on the left, a tabular subtotal on the right. Days: "আজ · Today ৳ 290", "গতকাল · Yesterday ৳ 2,320", "23 September · Wednesday ৳ 340", "22 September · Tuesday ৳ 1,150". Each expense row: a 34 pixel circular pastel category tile with a thin single-weight line icon, a merchant name in medium weight, a grey line beneath reading time · category · payment method, and a right-aligned tabular amount. Rows: Biryani House 250, Rickshaw fare 40, Shwapno 1,820, bKash cash out 500, Tea Stall 30, Lazz Pharma 310, Pathao ride 180, Kacha Bazar 350.

Pinned to the bottom edge, a 66 pixel navigation bar with a hairline top border: three items — Home, Drafts, Settings — each a line icon above a 10.5 pixel label; Home is active, its icon sitting in a pale blue #DCE9FB pill in blue #2563EB.

Bengali and Latin text both set cleanly. Flat lighting, no gradients, no glass, no ornament.
